items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; taps ~0.25-0.4s nudge, holds 1-2s travel (~2s shifts world ~100px; character stays screen-centered). Space = contextual action. LMB hover/select shows verb label; clicking targets directly does nothing useful. Escape = Paused menu (Continue ~(0.31,0.58)); pause freezes world. Craft UI open does NOT pause time. Tab = map (assumed, untested).

PICKING (observed): 'Pick X' appears only when close and roughly same y; farther reads 'Examine X'. Space with only Examine fails silently. Standing on a target flips Pick to Examine; step off/back. Verb label visible does NOT guarantee reach: ~160px was too far (sapling), ~90-130px worked. Confirmed yields: sapling -> Twigs x1; grass tuft -> Cut Grass x1; yellow flower -> Petals x1. Picked saplings become bare stumps ('Examine Sapling' = depleted). Depleted grass tufts render orange and show 'Examine Grass'; fresh tufts are bright yellow-green spiky clumps, typically at pine bases. Tree trunks steal hover from tufts at their bases -- aim precisely on the spiky glyph just beside the trunk. No-verb scenery: ground sticks/twigs, sprigs, red mushrooms (pickability untested), rabbit holes (only Examine), rocks (no harvest verb seen).

HOTBAR (observed): fills in acquisition order; slot centers x~0.135, 0.20, 0.26, 0.32 at y~0.93. Hovering a slot should read name/count but tooltips frequently fail to render, leaving counts unreadable. Green icons are ambiguous (Petals vs Cut Grass look similar) -- always hover-verify, don't assume.

CRAFT UI (observed): left sidebar icons at x~0.019, tools/axe ~y0.114, flame 'Light' ~y0.197. Hovering the flame only shows a 'Light' tooltip; an actual left click opens the vertical recipe column x~0.05-0.15, rows y~0.13, 0.22, 0.30, 0.375, 0.45. Hovering a row center x~0.10 is documented to open a right detail panel (name, costs as have/need, description, Build button ~(0.28,0.66)); Build may need a second click. Dark tiles = unaffordable silhouettes, bright = affordable. THREE SEPARATE RUNS: detail panel never rendered, even at night with the column open; clicking/hovering tile centers produced nothing. Guess: unaffordable tiles give no panel/action; or hover must hit the tile glyph exactly, or one click only selects. Assumed costs: Torch = 2 Cut Grass + 2 Twigs ('portable light source'); Campfire = 3 Cut Grass + 2 Logs; Fire Pit = rocks + 12 unidentified material. Unknown: identity of the bottom bright tile seen in early daylight (possibly a cheaper light), whether the column scrolls, whether recipes unlock from logs/rocks.

TORCH: crafting equips it in hand with % durability (~96 start, ~12% per action cycle, ~8 actions). Lit torch in daylight is wasted. Craft spares before dusk.

NIGHT: dusk message 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.'; then near-total blackness 'It's so dark!' with periodic 'OW! Something hit me!' and other messages like 'What was that?!' until death. A blue circular icon appears beside the Day clock at night (function unknown). Previously a daylight-held lit torch survived Night 1.

HUNGER: 'I'm so hungry!' warning seen. Petals hover shows 'Eat'; berries likely edible. Food mechanics unresolved.

TERRAIN/LOCATION RELATIONS (observed): start area was burrow-heavy open brown ground with rabbit holes, yellow flowers, red mushrooms, butterflies, redbirds/crows; saplings sparse. Pine/evergreen barrens contain most grass tufts, clustered at trunk bases. Long runs east/southeast crossed burrow savanna without finding a grass field. Yellow flowers are reliable Petal sources when approached closely.

FAILED/WASTEFUL: click-to-harvest; Space out of range; standing on target; hovering tree trunks instead of tufts; chasing tufts occluded by pines; treating ground twigs/sprigs as pickable; clicking recipe tile edges; leaving crafting until dusk; assuming all green hotbar icons are Cut Grass; wandering in darkness; retrying a failing UI hover/click during daylight (burned gathering time); long-range hover-pick attempts (label appears but pick fails).

LESSONS/HYPOTHESES: daylight is a hard deadline -- gather immediately, verify counts (tooltips unreliable), craft well before dusk. Night without a lit torch is fatal. A sapling gives only 1 Twig, so 2+ saplings are needed for a torch; gather a surplus (3+ Cut Grass, 3+ Twigs) rather than relying on exact costs. Grass is scarcer than twigs; search pine bases. Open questions: petals/berries/mushrooms as food, the blue night icon, whether recipe tiles need pixel-precise hover or select-then-Build, recipe column scrolling, and cooking/light alternatives to the torch.
